title: Kellen Moore on adding a receiver after Ja'Lynn Polk retirement: We've got a lot of guys right now

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kellen Moore on adding a receiver after Ja'Lynn Polk retirement: We've got a lot of guys right now
sources.description: The Saints lost a receiver when Ja'Lynn Polk retired over the weekend, but it doesn't sound like they feel an urgent need to add another one to the roster.
